data.one_liner: A comprehensive Flutter chat bubble library supporting Telegram, WhatsApp, Messenger, and iMessage styles.
data.what_it_does: Provides highly customizable chat bubble widgets supporting popular messaging platform styles like Telegram, WhatsApp, Messenger, and iMessage. It includes theming, callbacks, text formatting, media attachments, and custom bubble support.
use_when: You are building a chat application in Flutter and need pre-styled message bubbles.
You want to support multiple messaging app aesthetics (Telegram, WhatsApp, iMessage, Messenger).
You need advanced chat features like reactions, replies, text formatting, and voice message integration.
avoid_when: You are not building a chat or messaging application.
You want to build completely custom chat bubbles from scratch without adopting a library's structure.
strengths: Supports multiple popular messaging styles out of the box.
Highly customizable with extensive config, themes, and callbacks.
Includes support for modern features like reactions, threaded replies, and message grouping.
weaknesses: Tied to a specific package ecosystem for voice playback and platform utilities.
Deep customization beyond the provided styles and configs may require writing custom bubbles.
data.setup_notes: Requires adding the dependency to pubspec.yaml and ensuring minimum version constraints for Flutter and Dart are met.
data.minimal_example:
VBubbleScope(
  style: VBubbleStyle.telegram,
  config: VBubbleConfig(),
  callbacks: VBubbleCallbacks(
    onTap: (messageId) => print('Tapped: $messageId'),
  ),
  child: ListView(
    children: [
      VTextBubble(
        messageId: 'msg_1',
        isMeSender: true,
        time: '12:30',
        text: 'Hello! How are you?',
        status: VMessageStatus.read,
      ),
    ],
  ),
)
